//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the LINK typography component (svelte typography/Link.svelte, keen Typography.pa_link/1). SCOPE = a flat inline <a>. Core's blessed link is `<a class="pa-link" href="…">` — the `.pa-link` accent-coloured link (underline on hover) from _utilities.scss (snippets/utilities.html line 474). `.pa-link` is a FLAT base class with NO modifiers (no `.pa-link--*` in main.css); colour variations use the shared `.text-*` utilities via the class passthrough. The link carries a required `href` plus an optional `target` attribute. See label.json/code.json for the flat-element + attribute-convention models.

propsVocabulary.href: destination URL (required). Always emitted on the <a>.
propsVocabulary.target: anchor target (_blank|_self|_parent|_top) — a real attribute, emitted only when set
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (class passthrough — e.g. a `.text-*` colour utility; not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Structural + the href/target attribute conventions. The <a> always carries `pa-link` + the `href` attribute; `target` is emitted only when provided. Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks tag + class + attributes + nesting, not rich content. Class-token order + whitespace + attribute order are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. `.pa-link` is a real base class with ZERO modifiers (grep '\.pa-link--' on main.css is empty) and ZERO element classes — colour variants are the shared `.text-*` utilities applied via the class passthrough, out of scope here. The base class is produced by the block itself (always present), so there are no feature-produced modifier classes; href/target/slot/class are all structural → produces: null.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: `.pa-link` has no BEM modifier/element classes, so there is nothing for the axis-1 reverse check to claim beyond the base class itself (which the block always emits).

scenarios.name: target-blank
scenarios.note: target is emitted as an attribute only when set.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — a shared .text-* colour utility rides on the link alongside pa-link.
